headline: Viviana Power Tech announces amendments to its AOA and MOA
hook: Routine corporate governance tweak filed today
summary: Viviana Power Tech Limited has formally informed the stock exchanges regarding amendments made to its Articles of Association and Memorandum of Association. The filing represents a procedural update regarding the company's internal governance rules. Such corporate charter revisions are standard regulatory formalities for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock face no immediate financial impact from these administrative changes.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on your investment.

headline: Viviana Power Tech submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Viviana Power Tech Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The filing completes the mandatory post-AGM compliance process for the company. Indian retail shareholders can review the outcome of resolutions passed during the meeting on the exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on stock price
